sentences.text:
And Othe
Counsel for Applicant :- Dilip Kumar Singh Chauhan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Nisha Srivastava Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Nisha Srivastava, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that for the last three years, the applicant had formed physical relations with the victim on the false pretext of marriage and now was refusing to marry.
The statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. was also given that on the false pretext of marriage physical relations was formed.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 27.06.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the said two statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. and the law laid down in the case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071 coupled with the fact that admittedly relations span over a period of three years, the applicant has no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Anuj Singh be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0538 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Deva, District Barabanki, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
